description: Check a job by id: an entity generation job, or a request from chargen_generate_image, a fixed video, audio, image edit or workflow run tool from chargen_list_recipes, or a Pixel Sprites order tool. Returns status, the error on failure, and when ready the generation id or the media (media_type, media_url, page_url; a workflow run lists every output with its role; a sprite order lists every move or part with its animated GIF, its set_id and any Gold refunded). Checking a job never cancels it and never deletes or overwrites content. When a video, audio, edit or workflow job passes its time limit, CharGen records it as timed out and returns its Gold, whether or not anyone checks. Checking a completed generation may also file it in the folder requested at generation time.
